CT-003-CHIDI.title: The Dark Knight
CT-003-CHIDI.text: Omo, this is how you make a movie. The Joker was intense, but Batman's gadgets and the car chases? 10/10. No dull moment at all.

CT-003-CHIDI.title: King of Boys
CT-003-CHIDI.text: Eniola Salami is a beast! The tension in this movie is better than most Hollywood films. I love a strong lead who knows how to take charge.

CT-003-CHIDI.title: The Matrix
CT-003-CHIDI.text: The bullet-time effects are still the best ever. My only issue is the talking was a bit much, just give me more kung-fu!

CT-003-CHIDI.title: Brotherhood
CT-003-CHIDI.text: The heist scenes were clean! It’s great to see a Nigerian movie with this much adrenaline. More of this, please!

CT-001-KUNLE.title: The Black Book
CT-001-KUNLE.text: The pacing was world-class. A gritty, dark story that shows we can do thrillers right.

CT-001-KUNLE.title: Inception
CT-001-KUNLE.text: Deeply intellectual. Reminds me of why I love complex storytelling.

CT-002-SARAH.title: Interstellar
CT-002-SARAH.text: The physics, the music, the emotion. This is what sci-fi should be.

CT-002-SARAH.title: Contact
CT-002-SARAH.text: A bit slow but the scientific groundedness is appreciated.
